_meta.why: Per-surface Copilot quality floors: a corpus/prompt/router change may never drop a surface below these. Enforced by scripts/csa-loom/check-eval-regression.mjs (E4 workflow + full-app-deploy post-roll run). Mirrors the vitest coverage-floor ratchet convention (commit 14a16d8e): floors move UP only, via a dedicated ratchet PR.
_meta.unblock: Raise: node scripts/csa-loom/ratchet-eval-floors.mjs --write (raise-only, from measured runs). Lowering a floor is NEVER automated — it requires an explicit override commit editing this file with a one-line justification in the PR body.
_meta.note: RATCHETED 2026-08-06 from six MEASURED runs (GitHub Actions copilot-quality-evals 31064239486, 31066313217, 31074296718, 31076441393, 31078960472, 31095470421). Only `retrievalHitRate` moved: it is deterministic and was stable to within a few points across all six, so each floor is (minimum observed − 0.05), capped at 0.95. `groundingAvg` did NOT ratchet — three of the six runs were judge-less (null grounding), so the window's grounding evidence is incomplete. `passRate` did NOT ratchet — the window mixes pass predicates (`deterministic+grounding+productFidelity` vs `deterministic`), and a run that lost the grounding conjunct can only report a HIGHER rate, so raising a floor from it would pin it above what a healthy judged run can clear (#2992). Both refusals are the ratchet working, not a gap. The prior values were a PROVISIONAL SEED (2026-07-22) set before any run data existed. Floors move UP only.

2026-08-06.rule: min(observed over the 6-run window) − 0.05 margin, cap 0.95

notRatcheted.groundingAvg: 3 of 6 runs judge-less (null) — incomplete evidence per the E2 cap contract
notRatcheted.passRate: window mixes pass predicates (#2992) — a dropped conjunct can only raise the rate

metrics.retrievalHitRate: 0..1 — fraction of questions where >=1 expectedChunks doc surfaced (deterministic; authoritative even judge-less)
metrics.groundingAvg: 1..5 LLM-judge grounding average over JUDGED questions only; null in a run = judge deferred (E2 daily cap / no deployment) and is treated as NO-CHANGE by the gate, never a regression

_meta.deltaConvention: EVAL_REGRESSION_DELTA (default 5) is in POINTS: rate metrics compare in percentage points (0.05 = 5 points); groundingAvg maps its 4-wide 1..5 scale onto 0..100 (a 0.2 drop = 5 points).

_searchMeta.why: SRCH1 — per-domain federated-search (/catalog) relevance floors. A ranking/index regression may never drop a domain below these. Enforced by scripts/csa-loom/check-eval-regression.mjs (searchFloors path). Scored hit-rate@k / NDCG@k by the copilot-evaluator searchRelevance mode against the demo-seed showcase items.

metrics.searchHitRate: 0..1 — fraction of queries where >=1 expectedResults appears in the top-K returned by searchCatalog (deterministic)
metrics.ndcg: 0..1 — mean binary-relevance NDCG@k across the domain's queries

_tierMeta.why: E6 — tier-router decision floor. The copilot-evaluator tier mode runs the REAL routeTurnTier over the golden content/evals/_tier-labels.jsonl set and scores each decision against its expected tier; tierAccuracy is the fraction the router routes onto the labeled tier. A regression in DEFAULT_TASK_TIER_MAP or the classifyTaskClass heuristics drops accuracy below this floor. Ratchet-up-only, same convention as the copilot + search floors.

metrics.tierAccuracy: 0..1 — fraction of labeled prompts whose ridden tier equals the expected tier (deterministic; the router is a pure module, no judge spend)
